mapper.select: SELECT datasource_key, datasource_name, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, row_version FROM int_datasource_config WHERE datasource_key = #{datasourceKey}
SELECT revision_id, datasource_key, config_json, secret_id, checksum FROM int_datasource_revision WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO int_datasource_config (datasource_key, datasource_name, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, row_version) VALUES (#{datasourceKey}, #{datasourceName}, #{enabled}, #{activeRevisionId}, #{draftRevisionId}, #{rowVersion})

INSERT INTO int_datasource_revision (revision_id, datasource_key, config_json, secret_id, checksum, create_time) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{datasourceKey}, #{configJson}, #{secretId}, #{checksum}, NOW())
